User adjusts liquidity with min/max constraints. Similar to update but with desired amounts and slippage protection. Order: adjust pool -> conditional transfers with assertions.
Admin collects protocol fees from pool. Fees withdrawn from pool, transferred to recipient. Order: collect_protocol -> transfer token0 -> transfer token1.

value_flows.flow: amount_remaining (input) is decomposed into amount_in, amount_out, and fee_amount based on sqrt_ratio_current_x_96, sqrt_ratio_target_x_96, liquidity, and fee_pips. The fee is calculated via mul_div_rounding_up and subtracted from amount_in.
value_flows.order_of_operations: 1. Determine swap direction and exactness. 2. Calculate amount_in or amount_out based on target. 3. Adjust sqrt_ratio_next_x_96. 4. Compute final amount_in and amount_out. 5. Calculate fee_amount.

value_flows.flow: x (current liquidity) is modified by delta y (positive or negative) to produce new liquidity value. Overflow/underflow checks prevent invalid states.
value_flows.order_of_operations: 1. Check sign of y. 2. If negative, perform subtraction with underflow check. 3. If positive, perform addition with overflow check. 4. Return new liquidity value or error.

value_flows.flow: Tick index is used to locate word and bit position in tick_bitmap. Bitmap values are masked to determine initialized state and next tick.
value_flows.order_of_operations: 1. Compress tick to word position. 2. Calculate word and bit positions. 3. Apply mask to bitmap word. 4. Determine initialized state. 5. Calculate next tick index.

value_flows.flow: Input integer x is examined to find most or least significant bit index. Bit operations shift x until target bit is found.
value_flows.order_of_operations: 1. Check if x is zero. 2. Compare x with thresholds at each power of two. 3. Shift x right accordingly. 4. Accumulate bit index. 5. Return final index.
